question: Did the isolated public demo deploy without activating Alpaca paper trading or modifying pre-existing named resources?
assumptions: The active gcloud identity is authorized for project-757198e6-df23-4e75-b08.
The user authorized new isolated hackathon resources but prohibited changes to pre-existing resources.
HTTP health proves service reachability, not full browser behavior or broker connectivity.
selected_route: One new e2-micro VM in a new custom VPC serves the credential-free Streamlit demo through Nginx. A separate non-login runner remains disabled until private secret versions, GET-only reconciliation, and explicit paper-order acknowledgement.

verification.demo_network_policy: deny all IP access except localhost

claim_ceiling: C1 deployment mechanics and remote health; not full visual behavior, broker connectivity, production safety, profitability, or availability guarantee.
falsifiers: The demo service receives broker credentials or can submit an order.
The runner starts before secret reconciliation and explicit acknowledgement.
The deployed source does not match the recorded immutable commit.
Any pre-existing resource is modified outside the named AlphaLedger scope.
The HTTP health endpoint or application service fails.
cost_risk_budget: One e2-micro and 20GB standard disk in us-central1-a, with a frozen $10 event-period soft budget and no unusual egress.
stop_rule: Stop or disable the isolated resources on cost breach, unexpected exposure, service compromise, account mismatch, secret leakage, live endpoint detection, or any failed runner reconciliation.
